title: My family
english_paragraphs: A: Teacher Wang, long time no see!
B: Long time no see! Do you come to this restaurant to eat too?
A: Yes, my family and I are here for dinner. My friend said the Cantonese food here is delicious.
B: Are your parents here too?

A: No, they like to eat at home. My children are here. That is my husband, my grandson; that is my eldest son, Xiaobao, who is 7 years old this year; and this is my youngest daughter, Xiaobei, who is 5 years old this year.
B: Your family of four is so happy! Are the children in school?
A: My eldest son went to elementary school last year, and my younger daughter will go to elementary school next year.
B: Does your husband also speak Chinese?
A: Haha, of course, he is Chinese!
english_full:
A: Teacher Wang, long time no see!

B: Long time no see! Do you come to this restaurant to eat too?

A: Yes, my family and I are here for dinner. My friend said the Cantonese food here is delicious.

B: Are your parents here too?

A: No, they like to eat at home. My children are here. That is my husband, my grandson; that is my eldest son, Xiaobao, who is 7 years old this year; and this is my youngest daughter, Xiaobei, who is 5 years old this year.

B: Your family of four is so happy! Are the children in school?

A: My eldest son went to elementary school last year, and my younger daughter will go to elementary school next year.

B: Does your husband also speak Chinese?

A: Haha, of course, he is Chinese!
russian_paragraphs: А: На́ставник Ва́н, да́вно не ви́дели!
Б: Да́вно не ви́дели! Вы также прихо́дите в этот рестора́н поесть?
А: Да, моя семья́ и я здесь на у́жин. Мой друг ска́зал, что канто́нская еда́ здесь вку́сная.

А: Нет, они предпочита́ют есть до́ма. Мои де́ти здесь. Это мой му́ж, мой вну́к; это мой са́мый ста́рший сын, Сяоба́о, которому в э́том году́ 7 лет; а это моя са́мая мла́дшая до́чка, Сяобэ́й, которой в э́том году́ 5 лет.
Б: Ваша се́мья из четырёх челове́к так ра́достна! Де́ти в шко́ле?
А: Мой са́мый ста́рший сын пошёл в нача́льную шко́лу в про́шлом году́, а моя мла́дшая до́чка пойдет в нача́льную шко́лу в бу́дущем году́.
Б: Ваш му́ж также говори́т по-кита́йски?
reading_paragraphs: A: Nastávnik Ván, dávno ne vídeli!
B: Dávno ne vídeli! Vy takzhe prikhodíte v etot restorán poest'?
A: Da, moya sem'yá i ya zdes' na úzhin. Moy drug skázal, chto kantónskaya edá zdes' vkusnáya.

A: Net, oni predpochítayut yest' doma. Moi deti zdes'. Éto moy muzh, moy vnúk; éto moy samý starshiy syn, Syáobáo, kotoromu v etom godu 7 let; a éto moya samaya mladshaya dochka, Syáobéi, kotoroy v etom godu 5 let.
B: Vasha sem'yá iz chetyryokh chelovek tak rádostna! Deti v shkole?
A: Moy samý starshiy syn poshél v nachálnuyu shkolu v prošlom godu, a moya mladshaya dochka poydet v nachálnuyu shkolu v budushchem godu.
B: Vash muzh takzhe govorít po-kitáyski?
